title: Help, I don’t get any AL warnings in the Output tab!
summary: AL warnings may appear missing from the Output tab in VS Code due to an active filter in the filter box. Clearing the filter reveals previously hidden warnings without requiring recompilation.
key_points: The VS Code Output tab is where AL reports build infos, warnings and errors; the Problems tab is not reliable for this
Typing anything into the Output filter box limits the view to matching lines
Recompiling while a filter is still set makes all warnings seem to vanish
Removing the filter value shows every entry again, no recompile needed
If expected warnings are missing, check the Output filter box first

quotes.text: The moment we (unintentionally) enter something into the Filter box, we will see only output lines matching the current filter.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary cause of missing warnings: active filters hide non-matching output

quotes.text: If we compile again while the filter value is still set … the warning (or more precisely: all warnings) will be gone!
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that recompiling with an active filter permanently removes warnings from view until cleared

quotes.text: So watch out for the output filter box!
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the key takeaway for developers to check this often-overlooked setting
